subject: Internal: MAP wiring & stakeholder roster for Acme evaluation
messages:
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 18 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Internal: MAP wiring & stakeholder roster for Acme evaluation

Team —

We have the internal pre-kickoff this Friday with Acme (their formal kickoff is next Wed). I drafted a short mutual action plan skeleton and a proposed roster of internal owners; need quick alignment so we can lock invites and the collateral we send to their execs. Key asks:

- Confirm RACI on these line items (owner / backup): evaluation criteria, environment access, performance baseline, security review, procurement timeline.
- Flag any execs we should include on day 1 (I called out Sarah & Tom as their business + platform leads).
- Any redlines on the 8-week close timeline — will need a concrete gating condition for procurement (signed SOW or PO).

Attached: ACME_MAP_v0.2.xlsx (skeleton with milestones) and SOW_onepager.pdf. I will host a 30-min huddle today 11:30 PT to walk the doc for anyone who can join. If you can’t make the huddle, reply inline with your RACI recommendations.

Goals: leave Friday with a clean MAP to share with Acme and a clear set of who owns what during evaluation.

Thanks,
Vanessa
VP, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference

--- attachment stub: ACME_MAP_v0.2.xlsx (spreadsheet, 52 KB)
--- attachment stub: SOW_onepager.pdf (pdf, 120 KB)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 18 Nov 2026 11:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Internal: MAP wiring & stakeholder roster for Acme evaluation

Vanessa — thanks for the draft. Quick thoughts inline and RACI suggestions:

- Eval criteria: Marissa (owner) / Monica (backup) — I’ll own the success criteria doc and demos.
- Environment access (test dataset + VPN): Aditya (owner) / Rishi (backup) — Aditya can coordinate infra access; call out required IP allowlist window.
- Performance baseline (latency/cost targets): Rishi (owner) / Vanessa (backup) — I’ll capture baseline metrics and proposed SLOs.
- Security/compliance questionnaire: Monica (owner) / Rishi (backup) — Monica to lead evidence collection (SOC 2 artifacts, data handling Qs).
- Procurement: Vanessa (owner) / Marissa (backup) — Vanessa to lead commercial negotiation; Marissa to assist on contracts.

Two operational notes: 1) add a soft freeze on model/quantization changes once perf baseline starts; 2) put a calendar milestone labeled "Procurement Decision" at week 6 to force a check-in.

I can join the 11:30 PT huddle.

—Marissa
Senior Enterprise AE
Redwood Inference

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 19 Nov 2026 08:30:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Internal: MAP wiring & stakeholder roster for Acme evaluation

Adding procurement constraints from infra side:

- Acme wants a 30-day evaluation with an internal cost cap (they indicated ~$10k in hosting credits). We should surface what that translates to in token volume given our proposed staging config.
- If they ask for a VPC/private deployment later, the lead time is 6-8 weeks; call that out in the MAP under "deployment options" as an escalation path 
- For the perf baseline, I recommend we start with a 512-seq benchmark and a steady-state 50 concurrent connections sim to approximate their expected load.

I'll add a short appendix to the MAP spreadsheet with estimated unit economics for the staged config. Also, Monica — I may need the SOC 2 report pointer to link in the doc.

Rishi
Sr. Solutions Architect
Redwood Inference

From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2026 14:22:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Internal: MAP wiring & stakeholder roster for Acme evaluation

Thanks — I reviewed the MAP skeleton and pushed a v0.2 with two edits:

1) Security evidence list: added items and an owner column for each artifact (SOC 2 Type II—security domain, network diagrams, data retention policy excerpt). I pointed to the internal folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3cACME_MAP
2) SLA gating: suggested language for a soft SLA target during evaluation (latency median < 400ms for the benchmark).

Attached updated MAP (kept filename the same for clarity). Marissa — incorporated your procurement milestone at week 6.

If everyone is comfortable, I suggest we freeze the MAP for the Friday pre-kickoff send (so we present a single clear path to Acme). I also added a one-page "ask list" at the top for Acme to fill (contacts for VPN/IP, expected dataset size, exec availability).

Cheers,
Monica
Director, Customer Trust
Redwood Inference

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
Cc: Sarah Liu <sarah.liu@acme.com>
Date: Sat, 21 Nov 2026 16:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Internal: MAP wiring & stakeholder roster for Acme evaluation

All — great progress, thank you. Based on the alignment:

- Locking owners as Marissa (eval criteria), Aditya (env access), Rishi (perf baseline), Monica (security), Vanessa (procurement leads). Backups noted.
- Freezing MAP v0.2 for pre-kickoff share tomorrow (Fri) at 10:00 PT. I will send to Acme and include the one-page ask list and a proposed calendar with the Procurement Decision milestone at week 6.
- Action items before Friday:
   * Monica: confirm SOC 2 report pointer and drop link in the Drive doc (ETA: EOD Thu).
   * Aditya: create IP allowlist windows and short infra runbook (ETA: Thu EOD).
   * Rishi: add the token-cost appendix and perf-run details (ETA: Thu EOD).
   * Marissa: prepare pitch bullets for exec kickoff (3 slides) — optional.

If we get the above, I’ll send the MAP to Sarah & Tom and request a 30-minute pre-kickoff on Friday to align on scope. Thanks again — I’ll update HubSpot after the send.

Vanessa Ortiz
VP, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference
